basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

sub_questions.question: What do small and mid-size contractors need from a direct online marketplace to place and repeat orders?
How can the marketplace sell directly to contractors while no regional distributor ends its contract?
What marketplace blueprint and pilot plan can MetalCo's leadership and the regional distributors council approve?
Do contractors in the pilot region place first repeat orders through the marketplace's first version?
Does any regional distributor terminate its contract because of the marketplace during the pilot?
What business case and scale-up plan do the pilot results support?

drivers.evidence: the CEO, our Head of Sales and the regional distributors council

work.unit: Interview round with one stakeholder group
Customer segment tested with interviews and a prototype

phase_work.why: Three interview rounds at once, two segments tested side by side, then the blueprint; above the typical 5-8 weeks because interviews are added.

work.unit: First version built for a limited launch
Live test with a limited group of users

phase_work.why: The first version is built, then tested live with a limited group in one region, one after the other.

sizing.levers: A narrower first version would shorten the engagement most; a shorter live test would too, but risks too few repeat orders to judge.

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace blueprint and pilot plan, tested with contractors and with the regional distributors council.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Approve the blueprint and go ahead with the pilot in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Build a first marketplace version, launch it to contractors in one region and track repeat orders and distributor contracts.

gate.label: Pilot readout
gate.decision: Approve the pilot results and scale-up case to take to the 2027 budget round?

architect_notes: Stated 20 weeks is split 7 Design and 13 Pilot in proportion to the estimates; the work adds up to 19 to 30 weeks.
No Implementation phase: the marketplace is new, so the plan stops at Pilot and the rollout after it is not in these phases.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, digital product passports for construction products. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Customer segments are assumed at 2, small and mid-size contractors; a third segment would add 2 to 3 weeks to Design.
